items.title: Wells Fargo doubles bitcoin ETF exposure as institutions pile in
items.summary: Scott Melker breaks down the surge in institutional bitcoin (BTC-USD) ETF holdings, which reportedly reached a record 456,000 BTC. Wells Fargo (WFC) emerged as the largest reported holder in the cited data, with exposure equivalent to 30,553 bitcoin, up approximately 105% quarter-over-quarter.

items.title: 4 Wall Street Giants That Raised Their Dividends for Income Investors
items.summary: Four big banks keep lifting their payouts, yet each one hides a different threat to the next raise. One cut its dividend to a dime, and another sits on a capital cushion that is shrinking fast. Which check can retirees trust most?

items.title: Can Bank of America Sustain Its Robust Capital Returns in 2027?
items.summary: BAC's strong earnings, ample liquidity and solid capital position support 2027 shareholder returns, but regulatory and credit risks could pose hurdles.

items.title: Wells Fargo grapples with change in venerable business line
items.summary: The San Francisco-based banking giant is grappling with the impact of major changes in the food, beverage and agribusiness sector, including big shifts in how Americans eat and drink.

items.title: 4 Bank Stocks That Deliver Retirees Dependable Passive Income
items.summary: One bank cut its payout to a dime, another raised it 18%, and a third has not budged in years. Retirees chasing quarterly income will want to see which big lenders earn their checks and where the hidden risks sit.

items.title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
items.summary: Every one of these five bank stocks slashed its dividend in the financial crisis, yet a new rate cycle may be rewarding patient holders. Only one has stopped raising its payout, and another carries a hidden capital risk worth knowing about.
